# Draft:Shafeev Award

= Shafeev Award =
The Shafeev Award is named after Georgy Shafeev, whose research contributed to developments in laser-based nanoparticle synthesis. The award is presented every two years at the Advanced Nanoparticle Generation and Excitation by Lasers in Liquids (ANGEL) conference. It recognizes early-career researchers, including undergraduate, graduate, and postdoctoral scientists, for research related to laser-induced nanoparticle generation and excitation in liquids.
The first recipient of the award was Anna R. Ziefuss from the University of Duisburg-Essen, Germany, in 2024.
